query: The city wants monthly residential and small-business electricity use by ZIP code for its open-data portal. Using monthly_usage.csv in /Volumes/energy_catalog/energy_skills/eval/gdg/gdg-001 (California utility), prepare the public dataset as energy_catalog.eval_<ARM>.gdg001_public and tell me which ZIP codes are included.

Create a view over monthly_usage.csv in /Volumes/energy_catalog/energy_skills/eval/gdg/gdg-003 (load it to energy_catalog.eval_<ARM>.gdg003_usage first) that our load-research analysts can query without seeing who the customers are, but where they can still join months for the same premise. Write energy_catalog.eval_<ARM>.gdg004_zip and energy_catalog.eval_<ARM>.gdg004_total and list which ZIP-month cells you published.
